prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Four-frame 2x2 portrait sheet for a real video game sports commentator at the TOP of the screen, watching the playing field BELOW him.
Primary request: Completely new original fictional man. ORDINARY natural face, rough understated photographed human appearance translated into coarse pixel art. NOT comic book or caricature, NOT heroic, NOT polished attractive game mascot. Think a low resolution pixelized candid photograph of a slightly disreputable 50-something sports analyst. Average proportions, tired eyes, ordinary uneven teeth only visible while shouting, modest nose, receding messy graying dark hair, short unkempt salt-and-pepper beard, weathered skin. Charcoal tee and faded muted olive overshirt, cheap black broadcast headset with boom mic. He lives somewhere tropical but no tropical decoration. Slightly sweaty, believable, anti-establishment personal energy conveyed subtly.
CRITICAL BODY/Gaze: ALL FOUR frames he leans FORWARD over a thin dark wooden broadcast-booth railing along the bottom of each frame, shoulders relaxed and hunched naturally, forearms resting, CHIN LOWERED, face pitched DOWN about 25 degrees, eyes looking DOWN BELOW THE IMAGE at the action. Camera slightly ABOVE his eye level. Some upper forehead visible, NO upward gaze, NO head tossed back, NO showing off his jawline, NO looking into camera. He is watching a match below a balcony, NOT posing for a portrait. Natural varying head direction and hand postures.
Style: start from documentary photographic human anatomy and NATURAL unsaturated color, then render as coarse pixelized photo with clearly visible square blocks, approximately 160x110 logical pixels per portrait. Dither lightly in shadows, reduced muted palette, imperfect and gritty. No smooth painted brushwork. No comic outlines. No glamorous rimlight. No orange/plum promotional palette. Flat dim practical lighting, gray-beige skin, dull olive/charcoal clothing, smoky black plain background.
Composition EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows, each quadrant contains ONE complete chest-up portrait. All four quadrants identical framing and matching size, same man and outfit, same flat dark background to all edges. No gutters or dividers, no labels or any text, no titles. Each portrait entirely within its own quadrant. Overall landscape 3:2.
Top left: neutral, absorbed, mouth naturally shut, thoughtful brow. Looking down and slightly right. No grin.
Top right: mildly enthusiastic, small genuine half-smile, brow lifts a little, one hand gestures briefly toward action BELOW. Not a manic grin. Looking down slightly left.
Bottom left: stressed, brow furrowed, lips pressed, hand touching headset, head tipped further down.
Bottom right: shouting an urgent observation at action BELOW, mouth open naturally, leaning further forward, one hand planted on railing, eyes still aimed DOWN. No giant comedy mouth or cartoon eyes.
Constraints: human and ordinary first, his weird history will come through dialogue later. No guns, no drugs shown, no jewelry emphasis, no tattoos needed, no logos, no watermark. Crisp natural pixelized faces, ordinary restrained expressions except natural raised voice in fourth. Face and pupils visibly downcast in every frame.
